meta.name: design-taste-frontend
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为落地页和作品集生成不套模板的前端界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果厌倦了模板化设计，想要有品味的定制前端界面。
copy.tagline_en: Ship non-templated frontend interfaces for landing pages and portfolios.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of templated designs and want tasteful custom frontend interfaces.

howto.what: 让 Claude 做落地页、作品集或网站改版时,它会先读懂需求并声明一句设计方向,再写代码;改版前会先检查现状,产出避开千篇一律的模板感,遵循字体、动画、布局等具体规则。
howto.when: 用户要求制作落地页、作品集或做网站改版时触发;不适用于仪表盘、数据表格、多步骤产品界面。

say.text: 帮我做一个 B2B SaaS 落地页,要 Linear 那种简洁风。
say.note: 它会先给出一句设计判断,再按简洁风写代码。

say.text: 把我这个作品集改版得更有杂志感,保留现有配色。
say.note: 它会保留现有品牌资产,只调整版式气质。

say.text: 做一个复古粗野主义风格的个人主页,别用默认的紫色渐变。
say.note: 它会避开默认的 AI 风格,走粗野主义路线。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the brief, states a one-line design direction, then writes code. It checks existing sites before redesigns, avoids cookie-cutter looks, and follows concrete typography, motion, and layout rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to build a landing page or portfolio, or redesign a website. Not for dashboards, data tables, or multi-step product UI.

say_en.text: Build a B2B SaaS landing page with a Linear-style minimalist feel.
say_en.note: It will state a one-line design read, then code the page.

say_en.text: Redesign my portfolio with a more editorial feel, keeping the current colors.
say_en.note: It keeps existing brand assets, adjusting layout and tone.

say_en.text: Make a retro brutalist personal homepage, not the default purple-gradient look.
say_en.note: It will skip AI-default styles and go the brutalist route.
